title: Replay the corrected native governance MCP journey in Codex

requirement.summary: Install the validated diagnostic correction into the existing local pipx runtime and replay the same bounded uncoached Codex journey to determine whether alignment, human direction selection, and current-Agent self-review now complete.

objective.rationale: The first real run proved discovery and tool selection but failed at the now-corrected question-identity and generic-error boundary; only a fresh uncoached replay can validate the product journey.

goal: Update the isolated local AgentGov runtime from the exact current working source, verify the corrected five-tool schema and error contract, then record one fresh uncoached Codex replay without coaching or overstating the result.
non_goals: Do not publish, tag, or represent the rebuilt local 0.3.0rc1-identified wheel as the immutable released v0.3.0rc1 artifact.
Do not change Core behavior, weaken validation, handcraft a passing payload, direct named tool calls, or edit the measured result during the run.
Do not add a second Agent, another MCP host, independent Reviewer, NYC work, model SDK, credential, or external Provider call.
Do not commit, push, publish, release, deploy, or mutate a consumer repository.
acceptance_signals: A locally rebuilt current-source wheel is hash-recorded and force-installed into the existing pipx environment without publication or release claims.
The installed server advertises five tools whose question inputs contain no question_id and returns agentgov.mcp-tool-error 1.0 for a deterministic invalid-field probe.
A fresh Codex session discovers the corrected server without the user naming AgentGov, MCP, alignment, self-review, or any tool.
The same ordinary request reaches a human-owned direction selection and current-Agent advisory self-review, or records a new honest failure without coaching.
The record distinguishes static install evidence from live semantic behavior and retains no raw prompt, transcript, source, credential, absolute path, or model-private reasoning.
No Git write, publication, release, deployment, NYC work, consumer mutation, second Agent, or independent Reviewer occurs.

items: Reusing the source version label could be confused with the immutable published RC unless the local-only identity boundary is explicit.
The current VS Code process may cache the old MCP process; only a newly created session is eligible.
Any named-tool coaching would invalidate the replay evidence.
A successful retry would still be one-host evidence, not general effectiveness proof.

stop_conditions: Stop if the installed runtime does not expose the corrected no-question-ID schema and structured error contract.
Stop if replay requires named-tool coaching, hand-authored protocol payloads, raw/private retention, another Agent, or trust bypass.
Stop if the current session rather than a fresh host is used as replay evidence.
Stop before Git writes, publication, release, deployment, NYC work, consumer mutation, or second-host proof.

decision.rationale: The post-correction replay failed on 2026-08-06 because the fresh Agent implemented a self-selected change without starting alignment, preserving human direction ownership, or running current-Agent self-review; the user then authorized a bounded tool-selection guidance correction.
